target_text:
// What one apply_page_tok call did: how many K tokens were relevant, the
    // range hint to continue from, and which path served the visit.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The field type attn_stats::visit_path and its own comment (attn_stats.hpp lines 110-116, changed in this PR) already list the reader behind each path. The changed parenthetical repeats that list, so the sentence ends at the field's meaning.

Proposed:
```cpp
    // What one apply_page_tok call did: how many K tokens were relevant, the
    // range hint to continue from, and which path served the visit.
```
